metadata.description: Small Claude Code mods: lifetime token counter, usage limit countdown, simple TL;DR lines

plugins.name: lifetime-tokens
plugins.description: Counts every token you've used in Claude Code, what it would cost at API prices (/apicost), and your Token Wrapped (/wrapped)

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: Shows how much of your 5-hour and weekly limits you've used and when they reset

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: Adds a super simple one-line TL;DR under every long Claude answer
